# Page 3^page=3
© Idaho State University, 2021 SCOPE AND CONTENT NOTE The Map Collection is an artificial collection comprised of over 2,000 maps and atlases focusing on Idaho, the Intermountain West and the Western United States, including National Forests and National Parks. Included are topographic, soil, road, and tourist maps, flood prone areas, Metsker’s Atlases, and blueprints. ARRANGEMENT The Collection is arranged in three series: SERIES I is TOPOGRAPHIC MAPS created by the United States Geological Survey that focus on Idaho. SERIES II is FLOOD PRONE AREA maps created by the United States Geological Survey that focus on Idaho, and METSKER’S ATLASES, one for each of the forty-four counties in Idaho, with the exception of Elmore County. SERIES III is HISTORIC MAPS, TOPOGRAPHIC MAPS, BLUEPRINTS, ROAD MAPS, and TOURIST MAPS pertaining to Idaho, the Intermountain West and the Western United States.
